scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test test/target.test.ts test/protocol-policy.test.ts test/request-policy.test.ts test/bridge-*.test.ts test/profile.test.ts test/history-shortcuts.test.ts test/release-contract.test.ts test/package-config.test.ts test/icons.test.ts test/sbom.test.ts test/evidence.test.ts test/native-job.test.ts test/native-signing.test.ts test/clean-host.test.ts test/publication.test.ts test/workflows.test.ts
scripts.test:smoke: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/smoke.test.ts test/profile-smoke.test.ts test/author-parity-smoke.test.ts test/assessment-parity-smoke.test.ts test/ec-calculator-smoke.test.ts
scripts.start:author: electron dist/src/author.js
scripts.package:author: CSF_DESKTOP_PACKAGE_TRUST=local-proof CSF_DESKTOP_PACKAGE_SYSTEM=macos electron-builder --config electron-builder.author.ts --mac dir --arm64
scripts.package: pnpm run package:author && pnpm run package:assessment
scripts.release:package:macos: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.author.ts --mac && electron-builder --config electron-builder.assessment.ts --mac
scripts.release:package:windows: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.author.ts --win && electron-builder --config electron-builder.assessment.ts --win
scripts.release:package:linux: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.author.ts --linux && electron-builder --config electron-builder.assessment.ts --linux
